name: What documentation do I need for a short sale consultation?

mainEntity.name: What documentation do I need for a short sale consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a short sale consultation, you will typically need to gather financial documents such as recent pay stubs, bank statements, tax returns, a hardship letter explaining your situation, and a detailed list of your monthly expenses. This preparation is crucial for evaluating your eligibility and building a strong case for lender approval. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can provide a comprehensive checklist during your initial discussion, ensuring you have all necessary paperwork to streamline the process with your lender.
